test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: For excellence in the field of medical services, which of the following awards is given?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Dhanvantari Award__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• For excellence in medical services, **Dhanvantari Award** is given.
 
• Dhanvantari is the '**Hindu god of medicines and the physicians of the god'** and this award is named after this legendry god.
 
• Every year on **Ayurveda Day**, the Ministry of AYUSH offers the Dhanwantri Award that it established.
 
• It is given to** Ayurveda professionals** who have made significant contributions to the field and who meet the requirements listed in the IMCC Act's II, III, and IV schedule.
 
• The awardees receive a citation and a monetary prize of **Rs. 5 lacs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Daly Memorial Award:**

 
 
• For excellence in **undergraduate research in psychological science**.
 
• This scholarship intends to **offer financial support **to deserving Wah Yan students who lack the resources to continue their further education, whether at home or abroad.
 
• **Two components** make up the prize.
 
 
• Initially, the recipient of the award receives a diploma and a financial prize at the graduation-related commemoration events.
 
• A plaque that is permanently displayed at the psychology department will also have the name of the prize recipient etched on it.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award:**
 
 
• The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research** (CSIR) **in India awards the **Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology (SSB)** every year for noteworthy and excellent research in the fields of biology, chemistry, environmental science, engineering, mathematics, medicine, and physics, whether it is applied or fundamental.
 
• For excellence in the field of** science and technology.**
 
 
 
• **Borlaug Award: **
 
 
• **The Borlaug Award** is an honor given to distinguished **Indian scientists** for their work and contributions **in the fields of agriculture and the environment **by the fertilizer business Coromandel International.
 
• The award was established in **1972** and is named in honor of Nobel Prize winner** Norman E. Borlaug.**
